title: Who do you call at 2:14 a.m.?
caption: 2:14 a.m., Capricorn and Pisces on the phone, and the old storm story comes up: both of them panicked into a fish. One became a sea-goat, the other two fish tied by a cord. Who do you call at 2 a.m.?
